### Where do I go now?

These docs are structured in accordance with the [Diátaxis][diataxis] framework:

- If you're looking to get stuck in with the package quickly, head over to the [Getting Started](docs/getting_started.qmd) page.
- Would you like a better understanding of what Transport Performance is? If so, check out the [Explanation](docs/explanation/index.qmd) articles.
- The [How-To](docs/how_to/index.qmd) pages will provide you with instructions on things like retrieving input data.
- If you're interested in leanring how to use the package, head over to our [Tutorials](docs/tutorials/index.qmd).
- For more focused, technical details of how this all works, see our [API reference](docs/reference/index.qmd).

::: {.callout-tip}

If you're looking for a more ready-to-go, reproducible way to use this package, check out our [Docker image][tp-docker] 🐳

:::
